demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- India's industrial sector and expanding automotive manufacturing base are driving demand for anti-friction bearings, with growth from an expanding industrial sector, technology innovations and new applications.
- Ball and roller bearing solutions gaining popularity due to ability to reduce friction, improve efficiency and extend equipment lifespan.
- Transition to electric vehicles (EVs) could benefit manufacturers of specialized smart bearings, even though EVs typically need fewer bearings than traditional vehicles.
- Bharat Stage VI emission norms have changed bearing designs and altered demand …

moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- distribution: Company restricts exports to the most quality-conscious markets (United States and European Union), which account for the majority of its export revenue — evidence: has a 100% subsidiary in USA which also acts on the marketing front.
- technology: Among a handful of customized bearing manufacturers worldwide producing bearings of 1800 mm diameter — evidence: it manufactures bearings for demanding applications weighing from 50 gms to over 500 kgs, among the widest range in the domestic market.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Bearing industry is capital intensive, creating a threat of underutilization of expensive resources and lesser absorption of fixed cost.
- Continual increase in raw material and consumables is flagged as an area of threat.
- Increase in labour cost will have to be matched by a corresponding increase in productivity to retain competitiveness of the industry.
- The shortage of appropriately skilled labour is emerging as a significant and complex challenge to the company's growth and future.
- War in the Middle East, Russia-Ukraine conflict, trade barriers and elevated uncertainty are disrupting energy markets, commodity flows and global trade, which management flags as a backdrop risk.
- As India transitions to electric vehicles, which typically need fewer bearings than traditional vehicles, this could alter demand patterns for the company's core product.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Focusing more on the export front, with the majority of product range being an import substitute.
- Strict cost control and improving efficiency and production at all levels to enhance performance.
- Perpetual technical up-gradation and advancement, encouraging new development, continuous quality improvement, and application engineering / R&D capabilities to strengthen competitiveness.
- Sharpening competitiveness and offering various market-driven product mixes.
- Restricting export domain to the most quality-conscious markets (United States and European Union).
